note: Concession-run San Bernardino NF campground (Mountaintop Ranger District) on the north side of Big Bear Lake, 2 miles east of Fawnskin, across Highway 38 and a strip of houses from the shore: no direct lake access, boat ramp about a mile away. Snowberry is the RV hookup loop; its electricity can be limited when the campground is full. Big Bear Discovery Center across the road. --Claude
